faq_heading: Homes near Regent Christian Academy: your questions answered

faq.q: Does living near Regent Christian Academy get a child a place?
faq.a: No. Regent Christian Academy is an independent school and sets its own admission, so distance does not decide it. Ask the school how applications and wait lists work.

faq.q: How does the Regent Christian Academy home search find homes?
faq.a: By name: a listing shows up when its description mentions Regent Christian Academy. Ask Jared to watch for nearby homes that leave the school out.

faq.q: How much do homes near Regent Christian Academy sell for?
faq.a: Within 2 km of the school, 255 homes sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026. Medians were houses $1,335,750, townhomes $740,000, condos $557,500. A median is the middle price and is shown where at least 5 homes sold.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near Regent Christian Academy?
faq.a: Within 2 km of Regent Christian Academy the median was 32 days on the market, closing at 97.2% of the list price, with 6% of sales above the list price for the 255 homes within 2 km.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Regent Christian Academy?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Cambridge Elementary (1.1 km south), T E Scott Elementary (1.1 km north-west) and Sullivan Elementary (1.3 km south).

Regent Christian Academy is an independent school in Surrey, at 15100 66a Ave. It teaches kindergarten to grade 12.
Use the search below to see homes for sale that name Regent Christian Academy in the listing, then check the sold prices within 2 km of the school.
How the Regent Christian Academy search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Regent Christian Academy, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 2 km away. Use the sold prices below for the distance-based picture, and ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.
What homes within 2 km of Regent Christian Academy sold for

Between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026, 255 homes sold within 2 km of Regent Christian Academy: 106 houses, 141 townhomes and 6 condos. The largest group was townhomes, at a median of $740,000.
